out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt pressure building in head; 'instantly I was traveling at a very high rate of speed' after 'I let go. I gave up!'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described as a 'tunnel' but 'wasn’t a tunnel... more like a conduit' with 'gold flakes' texture; could 'stick my head out' and see stars/planets whizzing by with light trails.

arrival.other_being_detail: Shadow-like human figures in single-file line; later 'council of elders, dressed in white' at a long table; 'two Beings' above/right speaking unknown non-earth language with authority.

environment.environment_other_detail: Huge beautiful white city with buildings too tall to see tops; very clean/shiny; city itself emitted soft but sun-bright light without sun/heat. Air felt extremely light/pure and smelled very clean. Also saw 'window/opening' with piles of extremely white human femur bones; heard extremely loud industrial grinding/buzzing noises.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He reports deciding to return because he 'couldn't take creation anymore' and was exhausted by the 'dimension/reality windows'.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Later reported being told to 'represent' what he saw (meaning unclear).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Atrial fibrillation episode; emergency department cardioversion attempt with ketamine anesthesia and electrical shock.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Reports spirituality was 'greatly important' before; cites Matthew 4:4 afterward; states 'God definitely exists' before and after.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Extremely loud noises/buzzing; 'dimension/reality windows' of creation; council of elders; two authoritative beings speaking unknown language; piles of white femur bones; future visions.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel/conduit travel → arrival/path with shadow figures and overpowering divine Presence → views of bone piles and vast white luminous city → taken inside building with loud buzzing → life review on many screens → council/elders and two beings → future/dimension 'windows' of creation → exhaustion/decision to return → loud barrier-breaking sound → sliding back into body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated 'reality/dimension windows' that appeared one after another and 'consumed' him.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He states several arrival elements happened 'within seconds of one another or if not all at once' (path, shadow figures, Presence, windows/views, noises).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Tunnel described as a gold-flaked 'conduit' floating through space; 'window/opening' views of piles of extremely white human femur bones; enormous luminous white city that is itself the light; inside a building with hundreds of screens showing life events; repeated 'reality/dimension windows' depicting rapid creation/building of realities; 'council of elders' in white and two authoritative beings speaking unknown language; persistent post-event loud noise perception until later 'revelation' of the NDE content.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Instantly I was traveling at a very high rate of speed through what appeared to be a tunnel, but it wasn’t a tunnel. Maybe, it was more like a conduit.'; 'This presence or should I say ‘His’ Presence was so Powerful, evil could never dwell...'; 'The city itself was actually the light.'; 'My past flashed before me, out of my control'; 'Am I dead?... I am dead!'; 'I just got assimilated!'
